STBK.description: Set-Back Loads for Nonlinear Construction Stage (STBK). Each entry, keyed by its load id, defines a set-back displacement load acting between two nodes and is assigned to a load group.

NODE1.description: First node number of the set-back load.

NODE2.description: Second node number of the set-back load.

DX.description: Set-back displacement component in the global X direction.

DY.description: Set-back displacement component in the global Y direction.

DZ.description: Set-back displacement component in the global Z direction.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the load group this set-back load is assigned to. Must be an existing load group name (an empty string means no group); an unknown non-empty name is rejected.
